title: Traditional peeler
text: Traditional peeler. This is a traditional peeler, easy to use on fruits and vegetables. It fits well in my hand and is sharp enough to easily remove the skin/peel off of fruits and vegetables (I used this on potatoes and apples in the last 3 weeks). Very well made and fits well in my hand. Would make a great add-on item for a bridal shower or housewarming gift.
